items.title: Osaka Public University — nearly 500 servers offline
items.summary: A ransomware attack reported Oct 2 reached the university's virtualization infrastructure, took nearly 500 servers offline across five campuses, encrypted many backups, and may expose personal data of at least 130,000 students and alumni; classes were suspended through Oct 9.

items.title: Andersen Group listed by SilentRansomGroup
items.summary: The professional services firm was posted to the SilentRansomGroup leak site on Oct 6 with a claim of system disruption and a ransom demand; the claim is unverified.

items.title: SilentRansomGroup — redacted victim "A…n"
items.summary: A victim with its name withheld was posted on Oct 5 under a data-release countdown timer; identity is pending disclosure and the claim is unverified.

items.title: SilentRansomGroup — redacted victim "K…"
items.summary: A second name-withheld victim was posted on Oct 7 under a data timer, country unspecified; the claim is unverified.

ransomware.note: Thin month so far: only one independently reported named victim; the other three are leak-site claims relayed by an aggregator, two with names still redacted.

items.title: Amazon Bedrock — partial outage
items.summary: A third-party tracker listed Amazon Bedrock in partial outage as of Oct 9, with impact varying by region and feature; not confirmed against the AWS Health Dashboard.

items.title: Cloudflare — user-reported disruption Oct 8, Cloudflare One challenge issue Oct 9
items.summary: Users reported Cloudflare problems on Oct 8, and on Oct 9 Cloudflare's status history logged repeated incidents of Cloudflare One clients being incorrectly challenged on some sites.

items.title: Microsoft 365 — Exchange Online delivery and admin center issues
items.summary: IsDown logged minor Microsoft 365 incidents on Oct 5 and Oct 8, including Exchange Online email delivery delays and intermittent admin center access; other trackers showed no widespread outage.

items.title: AWS eu-south-2 (Spain) — single-AZ packet loss
items.summary: One Availability Zone (eus2-az1) in AWS's Spain region saw elevated packet loss on Oct 4; the incident is resolved.

items.title: Azure — two incidents across 18 regions in 40 hours
items.summary: Azure logged two incidents between Sep 29 and Oct 1 that together touched 18 regions.

outage.note: No major hyperscaler outage this month. Items are minor incidents drawn mostly from third-party trackers, which disagree with each other — verify on the vendor status pages.

items.title: CISA adds Citrix NetScaler CVE-2026-88779 to KEV
items.summary: CISA added a NetScaler memory-buffer flaw to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on evidence of active exploitation; the catalog shows a remediation due date of Oct 11.

items.title: CISA adds two Zammad flaws to KEV
items.summary: CVE-2026-102489 and CVE-2026-102490 in the Zammad helpdesk platform were added to KEV on Oct 2 based on active exploitation.

items.title: Denmark — CPR register access affecting about 8.8 million people
items.summary: Unauthorized parties obtained personal information linked to roughly 8.8 million people by abusing a company's legitimate access to Denmark's Central Person Register.

items.title: Double Counter (Discord security bot) breached
items.summary: An attacker broke into the bot's cloud systems on Oct 4; one outlet reports 28 million accounts exposed (IDs, IP data, emails), while another says the stolen bot token was used to spam invites across about 50 large servers.

items.title: Asos confirms customer data breach
items.summary: The UK retailer told the London Stock Exchange that hackers broke into a third-party platform hosting its customer communication data and took names and contact details, after a rogue app notification was sent to customers.

items.title: Frontline Education — employee data stolen via third-party software flaw
items.summary: Frontline is notifying school districts that attackers exploited a vulnerability in third-party software and stole employee information including Social Security numbers.

items.title: DTU (Technical University of Denmark) — identity system accessed
items.summary: DTU says data for up to 200,000 users may have been exposed after hackers accessed its identity and access management system.

items.title: KEV additions and zero-day pace both ahead of 2025
items.summary: An Oct 1 roundup counts 247 KEV additions so far in 2026, already above all of 2025, and cites Google Threat Intelligence Group putting the 2026 zero-day pace at about 11 per month versus 8 last year.

items.title: M 7.7 earthquake — southern Panama (12 km WSW of Pitaloza Arriba)
items.summary: The Oct 9 quake (USGS red alert) collapsed or damaged churches, government offices and hotels in Coclé, Veraguas, Herrera and Los Santos, injured at least 27 with no deaths confirmed in early reports, and closed schools and administrative offices; a Pacific tsunami warning was later lifted.

items.title: M 6.6 aftershock — 14 km W of Río Grande, Panama
items.summary: A strong aftershock on Oct 9 carried a USGS yellow alert and a tsunami flag.

items.title: M 6.0 aftershock — 7 km N of La Tronosa, Panama
items.summary: The sequence continued into Oct 10 with a magnitude 6.0 event under a USGS yellow alert.

items.title: M 5.8 aftershock — 1 km S of El Cacao, Panama
items.summary: Another Oct 9 aftershock in the Panama sequence, rated yellow by USGS.

items.title: M 6.3 earthquake — 102 km NE of Norsup, Vanuatu
items.summary: An offshore magnitude 6.3 quake on Oct 8 drew a USGS green alert with no tsunami flag.

physical.note: The Panama sequence dominates; casualty and damage figures are from Oct 9-10 reporting and may have been revised. The search surfaced no October-dated hurricane, typhoon, wildfire or flood reporting, so none is listed.
